description: This file defines the FilterInterface interface for Drupal's text processing filter plugins, including constants, method signatures, and detailed documentation on filter behavior and configuration.

classes.name: FilterInterface
classes.description: Interface for text processing filter plugins in Drupal, specifying constants and method signatures for filter behavior, configuration, and HTML restrictions.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the processing type of this filter plugin, such as HTML restrictor or reversible transformation.

methods.name: getLabel
methods.description: Returns the administrative label for this filter plugin.

methods.name: getDescription
methods.description: Returns the administrative description for this filter plugin.

methods.name: settingsForm
methods.description: Generates a form for configuring filter settings.

methods.name: prepare
methods.description: Prepares and escapes the text for processing, used mainly for escaping.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Performs the actual filtering process, returning a FilterProcessResult object.

methods.name: getHTMLRestrictions
methods.description: Returns allowed HTML tags and attributes or FALSE if no restrictions.

methods.name: tips
methods.description: Provides an optional tip or guidance about the filter.
